items.titleJp: 引[ひ]っ越[こ]し前[まえ]の手続[てつづ]き

items.titleJp: レストランの定休日[ていきゅうび]の変更[へんこう]

lines.en: Exactly. Plus, Mondays are often national holidays, so many people asked us to stay open then.

items.questionJp: この店[みせ]はなぜ定休日[ていきゅうび]を水曜日[すいようび]に変[か]えましたか。
items.questionEn: Why did the restaurant change its regular closing day to Wednesday?
choices: スタッフの数[かず]が減[へ]ったから
魚[さかな]の市場[いちば]が水曜日[すいようび]に休[やす]みになるから
水曜日[すいようび]にお客[きゃく]さんが少[すく]ないから
店[みせ]の掃除[そうじ]を水曜日[すいようび]にしたいから
choicesEn: Because the number of staff decreased
Because the fish market will be closed on Wednesdays
Because few customers come on Wednesdays
Because they want to clean the shop on Wednesdays
items.explanationEn: The manager explains that the fish market they source from will start closing on Wednesdays, so they couldn't get fresh fish on that day.

items.titleJp: 美術館[びじゅつかん]での案内[あんない]

items.titleJp: ホームステイ先[さき]での夕食後[ゆうしょくご]

items.situationEn: Your host mother finishes serving dinner and you have finished eating.
